context: Adding foreign keys from order_items and payments to orders to enforce referential integrity.
explanation: ON DELETE CASCADE means deleting a single order silently deletes every one of its line items and payment records with no application-level record, audit trail, or chance to intervene. On a high-traffic orders table this turns any accidental or malicious bulk delete into instant, unrecoverable loss of order_items and payments data. A RESTRICT or explicit soft-delete pattern is safer here. Should be rejected.
